title: Stop Asking Claude. Ask a Council Instead.
description:
Claude agrees with you way too much.

That's not confidence, that's a bug.

Stanford just proved it.

Claude flatters your big decisions.

That kills real critical thinking.

LLM Council fixes this.

Ask several models at once.

They read each other blind.

You get their combined best thinking.

Like a blind panel of judges.

Nobody plays favorites.

One AI opinion isn't enough for big calls.

The Council makes sure you get pushback.

Use it before your next major decision.

#claudeai #llmcouncil #aibias #criticalthinking #aidecisionmaking
